data.bioEn: Lead engineer moving deeper into Engineering + Applied AI — LLM/CV prototyping, platform delivery, and secure scalable environments for AI products.
data.bioAr: مهندس قيادي يتجه نحو الهندسة والذكاء الاصطناعي التطبيقي — نمذجة LLM ورؤية الحاسوب، وتسليم المنصات، وبناء بيئات آمنة وقابلة للتوسع لمنتجات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
data.summaryEn: Lead engineer transitioning deeper into Engineering + Applied AI, combining hands-on LLM/CV prototyping with strong platform delivery. Build secure, scalable environments for AI products (Azure/OCI, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, monitoring) and drive measurable improvements in SDLC, reliability, and deployment outcomes.
data.summaryAr: مهندس قيادي يدمج النمذجة العملية لنماذج اللغات الكبيرة ورؤية الحاسوب مع تسليم المنصات القوي؛ يبني بيئات آمنة وقابلة للتوسع لمنتجات الذكاء الاصطناعي (Azure/OCI، Kubernetes، CI/CD، GitOps، المراقبة) ويحسّن دورة حياة التطوير والموثوقية والنشر بشكل قابل للقياس.

data.role: Lead Engineer, Application Science (Advanced Technologies Lab)
highlights: Kubernetes-aware LLM converting natural-language intent into validated kubectl commands; QLoRA fine-tuning and safety controls (syntax validation, allowlist/denylist) with a 1,966-case evaluation suite.
Reproducible evaluation workflow for fine-tuning variants and prompting strategies; A/B harness with metrics (success rate, safety rate, latency p50/p95).
Multiple AI solution use cases for LLMs and computer vision; deployable prototypes with acceptance criteria (~10 stakeholder demos).
Agent-based eLearning platform as technical lead — architecture, delivery, and cross-functional coordination.

data.company: Saudi Company for Artificial Intelligence (SCAI), merged into HUMAIN
data.role: Lead Software Engineer (AI Lab) / Senior DevOps Engineer, Ops Team Lead
highlights: Led cloud operations team of 6; multiple AI apps across dev/test/prod — ~99.9% uptime, MTTR < 30 min, ~2–3 incidents/month.
Established Azure DevOps as standard; migrated SCM from GitLab and boards from Jira across 40+ repos / 15+ projects.
GitFlow + PR governance; ~35% fewer hotfixes/rollbacks across 5+ teams.
CI/CD + Argo CD GitOps — ~70% fewer manual deploy steps; deploy time ~45 min → ~10 min.
SonarQube + Black Duck across 35+ repos — ~40% fewer critical/high findings.
CI optimization — build ~18 min → ~7 min.
Azure AI landing zones; Fortinet FW/WAF; observability (Azure Monitor, App Insights, ELK) — TTD < 5 min, TTR < 30 min.
AI/ML studios & MLOps workspace — env setup ~5 days → < 4 hours.
AD SSO/OAuth for 10+ apps; Azure EA RFP ~20% cost savings; M365 email migration zero downtime; Cloud Fusion ERP + ZATCA VAT automation (10,000+ invoices/mo, ~60% manual effort reduction).
GitHub Actions CI/CD across 12+ repos — deploy ~30 min → ~8 min.
HA compliant Design System platform — 99.9% SLA.
Azure DevOps release automation, handover docs and runbooks.
Azure DevOps for 50+ projects; legacy migration to Azure across environments.
120+ CI/CD pipelines; 40–50 deployments/week, ~98% success.
Branch strategy & release management — ~30% fewer prod defects, ~35% fewer rollbacks.
Self-hosted agent pool (12) — ~60% shorter queue time.
Flutter mobile CI/CD (6 apps), bi-weekly cadence; DR RTO < 1h, RPO < 15 min.
Vendor coordination for corporate website — ~10 weeks, 20+ pages/features.
Internal systems evaluation — 100+ issues resolved, avg resolution < 3 days.
